title: P2P chats: user search, chat deletion, reactions, replies, AI chat badges
intent: Complete the social side of messaging: searchable user directory for chat membership, chat deletion, emoji reactions on messages, message quoting (replies), polished header modals across viewports, and visually distinct AI chats — backend contract first, frontend experience second.

requirements.title: Backend: users search, chat delete, reactions, replies
requirements.description: GET /users?login= search by login prefix; DELETE /chats/{id} (owner or member policy per review); alembic migration adding reactions (message_id, user_id, emoji, unique) and messages.reply_to_id; reactions API (set/toggle) with WS broadcast; reply_to carried in MessageResponse (id + author + content snippet) and accepted on message create; pytest coverage.

requirements.title: Frontend: modals, @search, delete, reactions, replies, AI badges
requirements.description: Header-button modals fully rebuilt (add-user with @login search results, delete-chat with confirmation) styled at all breakpoints; reactions UI (emoji picker on a message, chips under the bubble, own reaction highlighted, toggle); reply UI (reply action on a message, quoted preview above the input, quoted block rendered in the bubble); AI chats badged in the list and visually distinct; P2P flow usable end-to-end.

constraints: Backend migration is additive (new table + nullable column); alembic upgrade head stays clean on the existing volume.
WS events stay backward-compatible: existing clients ignore unknown event types; message content contract only gains optional fields.
Reactions are limited to a fixed emoji set server-side; one reaction per user per emoji per message (unique constraint), toggle semantics.
Deletion policy: only the chat owner can delete (decided at review if the model differs); members are not silently removed otherwise.
Frontend reuses the stage-15 bubble/adaptive patterns; no new media-query strategy.
Existing suites stay green (203 frontend, 152 backend).
